notes.title: Version 0.33.2 is now live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

A rather small update for you this week, I decided to take some time to hunt down and eradicate some of the pesky bugs that have been bothering me. It's not an exciting task, but when the game is being constantly updated it also means bugs sneak in and occasionally need to be wiped out. So here's what's fixed:

Fixed a bug where civilians that spawn outside building windows would get stuck trying to get inside in order to commute to work.

Fixed a bug where cops in the police station would stand still and do nothing if there was no more ammo in the police station, they had no more ammo and zombies were in the building.

Fixed a bug where the military drop zones weren't being reset if a simulation ended or was reset in the middle of the helicopters dropping off troops.

Fixed a bug in the visuals when manually selecting which zombies to infect where the mouseover visuals weren't working.

Tweaked the UI a little and fixed some of the buttons visually glitching when clicking on them and coming back to the same screen.

As always thanks for playing and see you in the next update!

notes.title: Version 0.31.2 is now live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I've added something that I know a lot of you have been waiting for:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jK36x04.png[/img]

Civilians now can weird melee weapons! 

When they become alarmed and turn magenta they will arm themselves with anything they can find before they start searching for a place to barricade.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Xgc8npY.png[/img]

I've rearranged this original hardly used melee chance stat for this new update. Alarmed citizens will no longer flee in panic from zombies and will instead try to get to their objective, whether it's leaving the building or getting to safety and will fight the zombies if they come within range. I've upped the chance to hit from a measly 10% to 75% so that their bravery in combat isn't always in vain.

This is a huge buff for survivors as now zombies have a much tougher time when someone is infected in a large group. It's not a complete buff for them though as fighting zombies often leaves them infected and continues the infection cycle.

At the moment civilians don't need to find weapons to arm themselves like they do with firearms, I take it as them simply grabbing whatever is close to hand.

I've also fixed a few bugs and tweaked some things:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in the last chopper update where military units sometimes weren't getting dropped off
[*] Helicopters are now correctly synced with the time bar at the bottom of the screen and don't run independently of game speed
[*] Survivors no longer block up rooms when they are hiding from threats in their strongholds, they have a bit more freedom of movement to go through some doors.
[*] Survivors were incorrectly determining that military were safety when the military were set to kill them. They will now flee as they should.
[/list]

This crosses another big thing off my todo list for this project! Thanks for playing as always and see you in the next update!

notes.title: Version 0.25.2 is now live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I have something hopefully exciting for you this week!

I've added a new state for the civilians to be in called Alerted:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xSgzscC.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NHO0gQZ.png[/img]

Being Alerted is a lesser state of panic than being Alarmed where civilians are complying with orders from the police, but they do not know the real nature of the threat yet. I'll try to break this down more by using examples.

[list]
[*] Unaware is when civilians don't know they are in a zombie apocalypse. They go to work, go home, all normal civilian duties.
[*] Alerted is when civilians know something is wrong, for example the police are evacuating them from a building or they have found a dead body, or they have encountered panicking crowds of people. They will want to contact the authorities and report the incident. They don't realise how bad things will become.
[*] Alarmed is when civilians know they are in a zombie apocalypse. People are dying everywhere, the cops are overrun, panicking and looting are taking place. This is when a civilian becomes a survivor. They will try to take shelter and do the things survivors do in zombie apocalypses. 
[/list]

Having a state between Unaware and Alarmed is how I'm going to be taking the sim moving forward so that I can have the Alarmed citizens do more dramatic things as part of surviving an apocalypse while still leaving room for people to do reasonable things when the magnitude of the threat hasn't yet been discovered. It also means that people don't instantly start barricading and such if a single zombie appears and the city is still relatively safe.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vHFSy7d.png[/img]

Here for example is a region where cops have evacuated the citizens out of the building. They are waiting outside to see what happens next. At the moment there are a lot of things I need to add such as giving the all clear if there is very little threat and the alarmed survivor features, but this is a start.

Thanks as always for playing and please let me know if you have questions about this new phase or suggestions!

notes.title: Version 0.23.2 is now live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I hope you are all having a good week!

This week I have added a little button to the charts screen that says More Stats:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9Nq6Ewb.png[/img]

When this button is pressed a new window will pop up that shows new stats that haven't been shown before! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PowjlR7.png[/img]

I plan to add more stats in future updates but for now you can see who has killed who, the peaks of infection and the methods the infected have been destroyed.

I hope this adds a little bit more interesting information that shows the kinds of things that are happening in your sims and help you determine what you can change to get different outcomes, say for example if civilians are killing too many zombies you could give less of them weapons and see how that goes.

I've also made a small AI change:

Cops will not evacuate civilians from the police station when they are in last stand mode. Previously cops would evacuate civilians from the building which kind of threw them out to their deaths when the police station was the last building standing so now they will not throw them out. I've been thinking that perhaps the cops will tell people to gather at the station or that people who don't have homes to hide in will seek it out.

Other fixes:

Fixed some bugs where clicking on certain icons was causing them to look clicked on all the time.

If there are any more stats you want to see added to this list I am open to suggestions in the comments! See you all next update!

notes.title: Version 0.23.0 is now live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! It's been a few weeks as I've been working on something rather large for this latest update so I hope you enjoy it!

I've been working on a rework of the interface to make it clearer how the whole simulation works. I have created several little cutscenes to introduce the concepts of the game and broken the screens down into different phases:

The phases are:

[h1]CITY GENERATION PHASE[/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YHcfpfH.png[/img]

Creating the city and choosing which kinds of buildings it has. I want to add an update where users can name their city and load premade ones, as well as giving people more options on how buildings are placed.

[h1]POPULATION PHASE[/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ULxng55.png[/img]

This phase is where the number of civilians in the town are added and given stats. Cops are also assigned in this phase and certain civilians are given vehicles.

Those last two phases most of you are familiar with, but I've broken up the Zombie stats page into two different phases explained below.

[h1]VIRUS DESIGN PHASE[/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1Q1u8bC.png[/img]

This is a screen where you specifically design how the virus works. Zombie stats will go here as well as information about how the virus spreads.

[h1]VIRUS DISTRIBUTION PHASE[/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/80n4UUE.png[/img]

This is the phase where you can choose how the virus is distributed amongst the population. You can pick individual units to infect or choose to spread it randomly amongst the population.

By breaking the different screens up into these categories I hope to expand on each one individually and add more options for each, as well as helping new users figure out how the game works via fun cutscenes.

I will also be adding options to roll back to different phases which sort of exists via the New Population and Reinfect buttons but presenting them in a more organised manner.

Do you like the changes or want to see more added? Let me know in the comments! Thanks as always for playing and I will be getting back to you with more updates soon!

notes.title: Version 0.19.4 is now live!
notes.content:

I've made some changes to how the Cop AI works. I was noticing that in the quarantine phase a lot of cops were becoming occupied on certain building layouts:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NLB8OfQ.png[/img]

Fixed a bug where people who were leaving buildings would keep doing that same command even after the simulation was reset, in worst cases this would cause all the cops to leave their buildings when a sim was reset.

I'm going to be taking a little break for Christmas vacation so there won't be some updates for a few weeks but after that I'll be ready to crack on with more features for the game! I hope you all have a good holiday season and I'll see you in future updates!

notes.title: Version 0.18.1 is now live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! This week is the next step of the Cop AI overhaul! Let's get into it.

The police station now has ammo reserves! At the moment it's just a flat amount (3000 bullets) but I want to allow the user to modify it soon. The AI has been changed to work with this new addition though!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xmcqaBf.png[/img]

When cops are out of ammo they will now withdraw to the police station, restock on ammo and go back into the field. This really helps cops deal with outbreak situations and they are a lot better at dealing with outbreaks now. I'll have to buff the zombies again in a future update to compensate!

I've also fixed the R rate display as it was pretty much doing all the math wrong since airborne infection was introduced. It should now accurately represent the rate of reinfection of infected survivors as intended.

Some small other issues I fixed:

Changed "infected" to "zombies" in some of the logs because of the existence of immune infected

Soon to come I will be adding a slider option to set how much ammo the police station has stocked. I hope you enjoy the latest update and there's plenty more to come!

notes.title: Version 0.17.2 is now live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! I'm excited to show you something I think you'll like this week! 

Introducing the Airborne Virus update!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RJO7er8.png[/img]

There is now an option in the zombie settings screen to have the virus be airborne:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GuxiNws.png[/img]

When this box is ticked the virus will spread between infected civilians who have not yet turned to the virus. This system makes Patient Zero scenarios where a single person is infected from the start much more viable and is capable of wreaking havoc.

I recommend lowering the infection rate if you use this setting as this now specifies the percentage of the population who will turn when infected. Previously this slider was used as a percentage chance when zombies bit a human that they would become infected themselves, but now I've changed it so that this percentage is used to calculate how much of the population have an immunity to the virus. 

This means we can have new interesting scenarios such as immune carriers who infect the rest of the population.

I intend to be giving the whole zombie settings screen an overhaul where I break it down into new categories soon which is going to hopefully make it clearer how these systems can be interacted with to create different types of zombie outbreaks.

I've also fixed some bugs:

[list]
[*] Units can now see when a unit is stood in a doorway. Previously zombies would not be able to see a cop that was stood in a door shooting at them, this and other situations should now work better.
[*] Fixed visual bug with the line of sight visuals remaining behind when a simulation is reset.
[*] Fixed bug where zombie settings screen would forget player settings about how they want to infect.
[*] Fixed the sim forgetting changes to the cop withdrawal percentage and setting it back to default every time the sim is reset.
[*] Changed the default cop withdrawal phase percentage to 50% as I felt too many cops were withdrawing to the station too quickly.
[/list]

Thanks for playing and I hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: Version 0.16.0 is now live! Stairs & Verticality Update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! This is the biggest update since DeadOS went into Early Access so it's a little special! After two months of work I am proud to bring to you....THE VERTICAL UPDATE!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40319778/571ccf20c267f9d48b9447cbf21f67c649a902ab.png[/img]

The buildings are now up to 6 floors high with stairwells between them. Nearly every system had to be altered, redone or improved to support this change. 

All of the buildings that were the previous defaults have been adapted into new buildings to support this as well as the level editor being updated so that you can make your own vertical buildings too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40319778/db819ec41819f10a0429195c061a19be47148f35.png[/img]

All the current systems in place should work with this new update including the Control Mode and the AI overrides. The military have also been readjusted to sweep these buildings. A lot of work has gone into the system that allows the units to enter and leave the buildings on their commutes / searches / hiding and a lot more will be coming soon to really flesh it out!

As a result of the work involved there may be some performance hits and bugs that will need to be fixed so bear with me in the coming weeks for future fixes and patches based on your feedback. One of the things is that you may experience a slower experience on very large sims. I want to optimise the systems so they will perform better soon.

At the moment all the blood trails still appear on the ground floor but I'm working on that. I wanted to try and get the build into your hands as soon as I could so that I could get your feedback and have more eyes on the game so that the bugs can be found more quickly, and to show that I'm still regularly working on the game and updating it.

I've got a large list of things I want to do next as a result of this update and this is the first step in bringing you exciting new things! I've purposely left the rooftops mostly open so that in the future military may land choppers there for example. Also I will be working on lots of AI changes to work better with these new systems.

I hope you enjoy this latest update and I'm super excited to get your feedback on it! Thanks for waiting for it!

notes.title: Version 0.12.0 is now live!
notes.content:
Hi everybody! Got some exciting things for you this week! The cop AI has been revised and a new system has been added to it.

Previously the cop AI would try and quarantine from the beginning, with a possible retreat to the station. Now they work in 3 stages:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Zuq915e.png[/img]

Incident Mode: This is the stage prior to the knowledge that a zombie outbreak has occurred. The police will hear about individual incidents and backup will be dispatched to deal with each one, as they would with any other crime in the real world. Each incident has marked a zone in blue. It is when they are overwhelmed with incident reports that they switch to Quarantine Mode.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yMmZwav.png[/img]

Quarantine Mode: At this stage the cops are all aware they are in a zombie apocalypse and try to contain the threat. Once in this stage they will start looking for infected survivors as well and remove them from the population. This mode is what you all mostly know from the game up to this point. When a certain percentage of cops have been wiped out (the default is 75% but you can change it) the police will go into Retreat Mode as a last resort.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CCYiTk1.png[/img]

Retreat Mode: The cops have given up on protecting the city and are congregating at the station in order to make a last stand. They will stay here until they are eradicated.

I intend to add more to this revolving around how the cops react to the station being attacked during these stages in later updates. There are a few other changes:

A random building will be assigned as a police station by default. Users can still choose to not have one if they wish or to change it's location. If a police station is not assigned the first two Cop AI stages will still take place, but not the Retreat Mode.

The Military overlay tab is now hidden unless the military are being deployed or are present, as it makes no sense to have a tab that doesn't do anything while there are no military in the sim.

Fixed a crash when using the Find Civilian tool and it would select invalid units.

I hope you enjoy the latest update!

Changed how R rate is calculated to better reflect infection.

notes.title: Version 0.8.5 is now live!

I have now split apart the Human + Cop phases into two screens:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/k3SbsEF.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3SS9odT.png[/img]

This is to make room for more options to come!

Fixed the Reset button on the Zombie settings page not resetting infections.
Fixed a bug where the user would get stuck on the Reinfect screen after all zombies have died.

I hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: Version 0.8.2 is now live!
notes.content:
Hi everybody! Got an exciting update for you this week, it's an infection update!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AC1Bgc0.png[/img]

From now on when people are initially infected they don't turn into zombies right away, they will be marked as Infected and will eventually turn into zombies. The setting looks like this:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/q5ioUnp.png[/img]

Where Zombify Ticks used to just mean the amount of time it takes for someone killed by a zombie to get back up, it now is the time it takes for an alive human to turn into an infected. I've also added a Randomize button so that the humans don't all turn at exactly the same time. This is quite a change to the way the simulation starts and I hope you will find it interesting to watch play out!

Notes:

Added an Infected counter to the stats on the bottom left:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/w5WJ7Yq.png[/img]

Added extra buttons for when a simulation ends to show the options other than nuking the city that the player has available:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/w11eCcC.png[/img]

I hope you enjoy this update!

More exciting things to come, but some weeks I just got to clean up the things I've already made ^__^

Thanks for playing as always!

Benn

notes.title: Version 0.7.1 is now live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Got another BIG update for you!

After the last update I got really hyped to try and push the sim to it's limits, so I've done a large optimisation rework of the city system and as a result you can now have up to 30x30 city blocks in your simulation!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oJCZj7L.png[/img]

While it still runs very well up to 20x20 I have put a warning when going higher as it can be seriously taxing on your machine, but now if you have a good machine you can test it to the limit! I think realistically I will never need to go larger than 30x30 for this game (though never say never...)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yZIrZhv.png[/img]

As you can see it is now HUGE! Be warned though, it takes a long time to load, especially with vehicles! I'd be very interested in hearing how this latest update runs on your machines!

Other fixes:

[list]
[*]Fixed bug where opening speed adjustment tool would set frame rate threshold to 0[/*]
[*]Fixed issues with the nuke having visual glitches with the new visual system[/*]
[/list]

Thanks again and I hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: Version 0.7.0 is now live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Big update for you this time!

The rendering system has been completely overhauled for significant gpu performance gains! As a result the max city size has been upgraded from 12 square blocks to 15, and from 10k max civilians to 25k!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oAEdxnO.png[/img]

I'm really hoping you will enjoy this update as it means larger simulations than ever before! Because this is an overhauled system I'd very much appreciate if you put in the forums any issues you encounter with poor performance or glitches.

Other patch notes:

[list]
[*] As part of the visual overhaul the blood now coveres the grid lines and turns them red.
[*] Fixed a bug when using Twitch integration where chat members added before the population were generated weren't included in the name list.
[/list]

I hope you enjoy this most recent update! 

Benn

notes.title: Version 0.5.1 is now live!
notes.content:
Hi everybody! This week is a lot of bug fixes and small tweaks that needed doing, here's the full list:

The first and possibly most important one is that you can now select units for control / renaming while the simulation is running. Previously you had to pause the simulation to be able to do this. I've been a little back and forth about this and I'd love to know if you think this change improves your experience.

The icons in Control Mode have been moved onto the floor:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yYJr2ZF.png[/img]

This is because when you are in this mode you need to click on the floor tiles in order to do the move / attack actions and I think having them on the floor is more clear in that regard and helps have less accidental misclicks.

Fixed a UI bug where ammo clip size was being set to 0 after the first simulation.

You can now use the escape key to quit the escape menu instead of being forced to press "Continue" with the mouse.

Fixed ammo drop light beams being dropped when cops / military have infinite ammo as they need no pickups.

Found and fixed a performance issue with the blood system. Previously at the start of the simulation if you had a lot of blood being spawned at once the whole game would stutter for quite an amount of time, this time should now be drastically reduced, though I will be tweaking the blood system more in the future, including an option to disable it for machine performance.

Fixed a bug where the Find Unit screen was causing the mouseover unit option to disappear.

I intend to next work on making the civilian AI more interesting for the next update, and thanks as always for your constant feedback!

notes.title: Version 0.4.6 is now live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! A small update this week:

Added a visual indicator for ammo being on the ground:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5gxmhBM.png[/img]

This should give you more info for your simulations about ammo usage as well as helping you find ammo when using Control Mode.

With this added graphic I discovered that cops + military who were "scavenging for ammo" weren't actually picking the ammo up. Only the cops + military who already had ammo were picking up the ammo they found on the ground. Whoops! This is now fixed.

The patch also fixes a visual bug with the overlay interfering with the nuke visuals.

Thanks for playing and hope you like the update!

notes.title: Version 0.4.3 is now live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Just a small update for you this week:

Users can now specify how quickly the helicopters drop off the military:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FoGXKid.png[/img]

The cooldown works in the same way as unit cooldown, with the chopper moving 1 tile per cooldown. The default for this before was 1 tile per second so now you can crank it up to 1 tile per 0.05 seconds (or 20 tiles per second) if you like.

Other patch notes:

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where populate button could be pressed repeatedly after it disappears causing the game to crash
[*] Fixed a UI bug with the total cops slider
[*] Added to the in-game log more information about when zombies outnumber cops and vice versa
[/list]

Coming soon: I'm working on a graph screen to show stats about the simulations but it's going to take a bit longer so I haven't included it in this update. 

Thanks again and I look forward to your feedback as always!

notes.title: Version 0.4.2 is now live!
notes.content:
Hi everybody! Another AI update for you this week!

This time it's the Cop / Military AI that is getting some attention as the zombie update has left them in trouble with being overrun!

First thing is, cops / military will now take a step backward when a zombie is in it's immediate vicinity. This is quite a big change as it means cops will retreat backwards as zombies advance towards them and fixes a lot of issues where quarantine lines were being overrun in weird ways. It won't help them if they get too overrun though...

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YVjblDl.png[/img]

Cops and Military will now advance into regions they have blockaded and will break windows to do so. When they have surrounded an area and there are surplus units behind the blockade they will advance forward. This is to further help break the stalemates where zombies are surrounded in buildings but the player has to wait a long time for the zombie to eventually stagger out.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5g5kOg6.png[/img]

Between these two AI upgrades the cops / military have become a lot stronger than they used to be. To reflect this I have tweaked the default scenario values so that there is half the amount of cops and the zombies are capable of taking an additional hit.

Other patch notes:

[list]
[*]Military units now correctly show stats about zombie kills and ammo count
[*]Fixed the mouseover unit ui from breaking causing the user to be unable to select units for renaming / control
[/list]

Thanks for playing the game and I look forward to hearing your feedback on the AI changes!

notes.title: Version 0.4.0 is now live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Almost one month since release and it's time for the

[b]MILITARY UPDATE![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0G76hRV.png[/img]

Users can now Call In Military from the escape menu during a simulation or after all humans have been eradicated. It looks like this:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7Sr4lgL.png[/img]

Choppers drop a chosen amount of troops at each crossing intersection. They can be used as many times as you desire once the previous choppers have left the area.

The AI for the military is currently the same as the Cop AI, so at the moment they are essentially cop reinforcements, but Military AI is planned for the next update!

There are also some other bug fixes in this patch:

[list]
[*]Fixed bug where user could select and control a unit while on the Escape Menu
[*]Fixed bug where pausing simulation and opening Tweak Speed screen would cause reinfect button to appear incorrectly on return
[/list]

Please let me know in the Steam Discussions what you think of this latest update, and especially how you want to see the AI work for these new unit types.

Thank you!
